construction.implementation_origin: Original integrated implementation authored for this build

shared_schema.input: Strict envelope: schema_version, fixture_label, preferences, documents, extraction_schema
shared_schema.preferences: interests maps case-sensitive tags to positive finite weights <= 1000000; excluded_ids and excluded_tags are unique string arrays; limit is a nonnegative integer
shared_schema.documents: Unique id, title, unique case-sensitive tags, and text
shared_schema.extraction_schema: Nonempty list of unique name and label definitions with type string or integer and boolean required
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks input, grounded recommendation handoff, and final source-grounded output. Unknown input keys and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.
shared_schema.source_spans: Half-open Unicode character offsets relative to the original document text; text stores the exact trimmed source substring
shared_schema.errors: File, JSON and validation errors print one JSON object with status error and exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input feeds deterministic preference ranking and exclusion filtering
Extraction validates the complete ranking handoff against source preferences and catalog
Only selected documents are extracted, preserving recommendation order, document ID and one-based rank
Shared validation verifies the final output before CLI serialization

behavior.ranking: Sum weights for matched tags, exclude IDs/tags before ranking, omit nonmatches, descending score then ascending ID, apply limit
behavior.explanations: List only matched catalog tags and their actual preference weights
behavior.extraction: First exact case-sensitive Label: value line; horizontal indentation allowed; trimmed nonempty value; integer values accept signed ASCII decimal digits
behavior.missing: Absent or blank first value produces null value/span and missing_fields entry; required fields additionally appear in missing_required_fields
behavior.invalid_values: Nonempty invalid integer in a selected document fails the pipeline; unselected document contents are not extracted
behavior.fixture_data: All example documents are explicitly labeled synthetic
